title: Fare Price Volatility by Route
dataSources: ADS-B aircraft snapshots (`adsb:aircraft`), personal flight logbook (`flight:log`), commute trips (`commute:trip`), transit arrivals (`transit:arrival`), geofence events (`geofence:event`), travel documents (`travel:document`), fare quotes (`airprice:quote`).
app: Home ADS-B receiver (dump1090 / readsb / tar1090 JSON feed), personal flight logbook exports, commute/transit APIs, and phone geofence webhooks via Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=airprice:quote
| bin _time span=1d
| stats min(price_usd) as low, max(price_usd) as high by route _time
| eval swing_pct=round(100*(high-low)/low,1)
| where swing_pct>15
| sort - swing_pct
description: Measures how much a route's quoted price swings within the day so you can tell whether it is worth watching closely or simply booking when convenient.
value: Some routes are stable and some are chaotic; a volatility metric helps you spend attention where it might actually save money.
implementation: Forward tracked airfare quotes into Splunk; review daily swing percentage by route before setting notification thresholds or booking timing rules.
visualization: Daily route table of lowest price, highest price, and swing percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks which flight routes are bouncing around in price the most during the day.
